title: Cocone evaluation is invariant under coherent Hom transitions
statement:
Let $I$ be a preordered set and $(T_{ij},\Phi_i,\theta_{ij})$ a cocone of categories with vertex $\mathcal D$ [det-def-sfb-filtered-two-colimit-cocone], so $\theta_{ij}:\Phi_jT_{ij}\cong\Phi_i$. Give natural isomorphisms $\tau_{ijk}:T_{jk}T_{ij}\cong T_{ik}$ and assume, for $i\le k\le n$,
$$\theta_{in}=\theta_{ik}\circ(\theta_{kn})_{T_{ik}}\circ\Phi_n(\tau_{ikn})^{-1}.$$
For $a=(i,x)$, $b=(j,y)$, $k\ge i,j$ and $g:T_{ik}x\to T_{jk}y$, define
$$P^{ab}_k(g)=\theta_{jk,y}\circ\Phi_k(g)\circ\theta_{ik,x}^{-1},\qquad t^{ab}_{kn}(g)=\tau_{jkn,y}\circ T_{kn}(g)\circ\tau_{ikn,x}^{-1}.$$
These are well-typed maps, and for $k\le n$ one has $P^{ab}_n(t^{ab}_{kn}(g))=P^{ab}_k(g)$. The compatibility identities at the two endpoints give
$$\theta_{in,x}^{-1}=\Phi_n(\tau_{ikn,x})\theta_{kn,T_{ik}x}^{-1}\theta_{ik,x}^{-1},\qquad \theta_{jn,y}=\theta_{jk,y}\theta_{kn,T_{jk}y}\Phi_n(\tau_{jkn,y})^{-1},$$
and the invariant value is explicitly
$$P^{ab}_n(t^{ab}_{kn}g)=\theta_{jk,y}\theta_{kn,T_{jk}y}\Phi_nT_{kn}(g)\theta_{kn,T_{ik}x}^{-1}\theta_{ik,x}^{-1}=P^{ab}_k(g).$$
For $c=(l,z)$ and a stage $k\ge i,j,l$, these maps satisfy
$$P^{ac}_k(h\circ g)=P^{bc}_k(h)\circ P^{ab}_k(g),\qquad P^{aa}_k(\mathrm{id}_{T_{ik}x})=\mathrm{id}_{\Phi_i x}.$$
If also $T_{ii}=\mathrm{Id}$, the diagonal representative has $P^{aa}_i(\mathrm{id}_x)=\mathrm{id}_{\Phi_i x}$. Neither directedness nor the pentagon for $\tau$ is required for these stagewise assertions.
